Host_Context_SD.note: Broad existing context field. Production and exposure context should use dedicated axes when available.

conflict_handling.conflicting_health_state: Clear incorrect disease field but do not overwrite incompatible existing health state.
conflict_handling.destination_conflict: Do not overwrite. Under set_when_blank_or_same_preserve_existing, existing different destination values are exported as no-op/review signals; true overwrite attempts are hard failures.

legacy_compatibility_fields.Isolation_Source_SD: Backward-compatible normalized physical/environmental/local source; preserve during Phase 2A.
legacy_compatibility_fields.Isolation_Source_SD_Broad: Broad source-context umbrella; preserve during Phase 2A.
legacy_compatibility_fields.Sample_Type_SD: Backward-compatible NCBI-style sample type umbrella; preserve during Phase 2A.
legacy_compatibility_fields.Sample_Type_SD_Broad: Backward-compatible broad sample type/context umbrella; preserve during Phase 2A.

missing_value_policy.additive_fields: Populate only from explicit reviewed rules and evidence-gated conditions.
missing_value_policy.patient_without_host_evidence: Do not infer human; populate only clinical sampling context.
missing_value_policy.strict_fields: Leave blank when evidence is absent or conflicting.

non_goals: no production rule change by this contract alone
no broad remapping of legacy compatibility fields in Phase 2A

patient_policy.without_human_evidence: Use Sampling_Context_SD=clinical subject; do not infer Host_Context_SD=human-associated.

physical_healthcare_facility_policy.policy: A physical healthcare facility may populate Environment_Local_Scale_SD. Host care status must not populate Environment_Local_Scale_SD unless the phrase explicitly describes a physical sampled facility.

site_precedence.Host_Anatomical_Site_SD: Use for anatomical part of a confirmed biological host.
site_precedence.Isolation_Site_SD: Use for sampling/isolation site when host linkage is absent, uncertain, or retained for legacy compatibility.

Environment_Local_Scale_SD.note: Physical local environment or facility only. Inpatient/outpatient/hospitalized care status belongs in host care/hospitalization axes.
